about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, for a detail-oriented and organised Accounts Clerk to join its Finance Department in Gżira.

You will support daily accounting operations, focusing on bank reconciliations, invoice processing, local and international payments and general financial administration, and you will help the team meet month-end and year-end deadlines.

It is a good opportunity for someone who wants to develop an accounting career in a professional environment. The role is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance and an employee loyalty card.
responsibilities: Carry out daily accounting and administrative duties within the Finance Department
Post sales, purchase and nominal ledger invoices accurately
Process payment requests and prepare local and international payments
Issue and process invoices as instructed by supervisors
Handle banking and cashiering transactions and carry out bank reconciliations
Investigate and clear outstanding items found during reconciliations
Assist with verifying and reconciling Goods Received Notes (GRNs)
Help the Finance team meet month-end deadlines and process payments on time
Assist with month-end and year-end closing procedures
Provide general administrative support, including answering calls, filing and handling documentation
Work closely with colleagues in the Accounts and Logistics teams
Follow company procedures, internal policies and health and safety requirements
requirements: A-Level qualification in Accounts and/or an AAT qualification
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships
Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
Ability to work accurately, manage deadlines and prioritise tasks
A team-oriented approach and willingness to support colleagues
offer: The opportunity to gain experience within an established automotive group
A professional and supportive working environment
skills: Sales, purchase and nominal ledger posting
preferred: Previous experience in a similar accounting or finance role
languages: English — working language of the team
company: Our client is a well-established automotive group in Malta whose Finance Department works from Gżira alongside its Accounts and Logistics teams.
location_text: Gżira is a central town on Malta's north-east coast, bordering Sliema, Msida and Ta' Xbiex, with seafront bus routes that make it an easy commute from most of the island.
howto: If you have an eye for detail and want to grow your accounting career, apply online through Outreach Recruitment using the form on this page. We aim to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
